note: Operational lore for the multi-host build. Read before re-deriving from docs.

hosts.host-a: backend present, real CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN — use with host-b for every multi-host proof
hosts.host-b: backend present, second host of the pair
hosts.host-no-backend: claude absent from PATH — the backend-absent provisioning route
hosts.host-logged-out: claude present, no credential — the logged-out route

rig.launchd: /Users/tomchambers/patch-test-rig/bin/host-service.sh <id> install|start|stop|restart|status|uninstall; point hosts/<id>/daemon-bin at the built daemon rather than editing plists
rig.linux: /Users/tomchambers/patch-test-rig/linux/run.sh up|sh|user|down — systemd images are debian:12, NOT ubuntu (systemd 255 will not boot under qemu on Apple Silicon)
rig.vendor: pinned Node 22 runtimes and onnxruntime-node prebuilds under vendor/; silero_vad.onnx in vendor/models

traps: Signing with --options runtime MUST pass /Users/tomchambers/patch-test-rig/vendor/daemon-entitlements.plist (PATCH_CODESIGN_ENTITLEMENTS in the rig's env/patch-test.env). Without it the artifact passes codesign --verify and then dies on first run.
macOS x64 is not a target — onnxruntime-node ships no darwin-x64 binary. Build macOS arm64 and Linux x64/arm64 only (spec/11-deployment.md).
A sandboxed HOME cannot see the user's login keychain, which is how test hosts stay isolated from his own Claude credential. Do not work around it.
Never touch the production Hetzner box, never deploy, never merge to main.
No fixture exists for forcing a provider models endpoint to return non-2xx. Inject at the network layer of the real daemon; the plan forbids mocking the daemon.

BLOCKER: the server registry holds ONE daemonKey (registry.ts:294; ws-hub.ts:165 comment 'B1 widens the record to a set'). Two machines cannot both register until group B1 ships — the second daemon is refused 4401 'unknown daemon'. Every A-vs-B TA1 test is blocked by that build gap, not by the stack.

Surface WS hello must use clientType 'surface-web' (ClientType enum is surface-cli|surface-web|surface-desktop|surface-mobile|surface-voice-device|daemon). 'web' closes the socket 4400 'malformed frame'.

mint-surface-jwt must run BEFORE mint-daemon-key (it creates <dataDir>/.user-keypair.json + bootstraps the account), and both must run BEFORE the server boots — the server reads registry.json once at startup.

The Kokoro sidecar port 5019 is hard-coded in packages/daemon/src/audio/kokoro.ts (no env override for the daemon's own choice). A second daemon on the same box must be given KOKORO_SIDECAR_URL=ws://127.0.0.1:5019 to reuse the first real sidecar instead of colliding.

Vite's port is strictPort 5173 in packages/web/vite.config.ts; pass `--port

--strictPort` on the CLI to move it. packages/web/playwright.config.ts pins baseURL localhost:5173 and spawns its OWN dev server, so UI e2e is a separate, contract-pinned surface from this stack's :41741.
Sourcing the rig's env files with `set -a; . file` breaks on unquoted spaces (CSC_NAME=Patch Self-Signed Test → 'Self-Signed: command not found'). Quote space-bearing values first.

Run the daemon as `packages/daemon/node_modules/.bin/tsx packages/daemon/src/index.ts`, not via pnpm: the rig's sandboxed HOME has no pnpm on PATH. Keep hosts/<id>/bin FIRST on PATH so the sandbox `claude` shim wins over /opt/homebrew/bin/claude (the user's own).

SDK_BACKEND has no default — the daemon refuses to boot without an explicit 'real' or 'mock'. KOKORO_MODEL_PATH (a directory, models/kokoro) and VAD_MODEL_PATH are validated eagerly at boot and abort loudly if absent.

GOOGLE_OAUTH_REDIRECT_URI was repointed at http://127.0.0.1:41712/api/oauth/google/callback, which is almost certainly NOT a registered redirect URI in the Google Cloud OAuth client — the Google OAuth loopback flow will fail until that URI is added (not needed for TA1).

RESOLVED: the old 'server registers only ONE machine' blocker is gone — group B1 shipped. registry.ts keys daemonKeys by daemonId and adds rather than overwrites; three daemons now register and authenticate concurrently. Do not re-report it as a blocker.

The server reads registry.json ONCE at boot. Minting a NEW daemon key (or any registry change made from outside) requires a server restart before that machine can hello. New SURFACE JWTs are accepted live with no restart.
Ordering: fixtures:mint-surface-jwt MUST run before fixtures:mint-daemon-key (it creates <dataDir>/.user-keypair.json and bootstraps the account), and both before the server boots.
Surface WS hello must use clientType 'surface-web' (enum: surface-cli|surface-web|surface-desktop|surface-mobile|surface-voice-device|daemon). 'web' closes the socket 4400 'malformed frame'.
host-b's hostName is 'beta-box', NOT 'host-b' — a rename persisted in its host.json from an earlier run. Address it by daemonId 'host-b'; assert display name from the live greeting, not from the id.

host-logged-out (:42751) is registered, online, credential-less and has never read a catalogue — use it for the unauthenticated-report and no-catalogue-spawn tests instead of destroying host-a/host-b's real Claude credential.

Daemons run under tsx WITHOUT watch: any packages/daemon code change needs /Users/tomchambers/patch-test-rig/work/tb1-stack/restart-daemons.sh. The server runs tsx watch and reloads itself (but still won't re-read registry.json).

Kokoro sidecar port 5019 is hard-coded in packages/daemon/src/audio/kokoro.ts — pinned by contract, cannot be moved. Only the first daemon may spawn it; every additional host needs KOKORO_SIDECAR_URL=ws://127.0.0.1:5019.

Vite is strictPort 5173 in packages/web/vite.config.ts; this stack passes --port 42741 --strictPort on the CLI. packages/web/playwright.config.ts pins baseURL localhost:5173 and spawns its OWN dev server, so UI e2e is a separate contract-pinned surface from :42741.

Optional components download to $PATCH_HOME/components per host (packages/daemon/src/index.ts:389) — genuinely per-machine and currently empty on all three hosts, so install/remove byte-on-disk assertions are clean.
GET /api/folders returns roots:[] for every host right now; the folder-registry tests must add roots themselves rather than expecting seeded ones.

Run the daemon as packages/daemon/node_modules/.bin/tsx packages/daemon/src/index.ts, not via pnpm — the sandboxed HOME has no pnpm on PATH. Keep hosts/<id>/bin FIRST on PATH so the sandbox `claude` shim wins over /opt/homebrew/bin/claude.

SDK_BACKEND has no default — the daemon refuses to boot without an explicit 'real' or 'mock'. KOKORO_MODEL_PATH (a directory) and VAD_MODEL_PATH are validated eagerly at boot and abort loudly if absent.
Sourcing the rig env files with `set -a; . file` breaks on unquoted spaces (CSC_NAME=Patch Self-Signed Test). Keep space-bearing values quoted.

GOOGLE_OAUTH_REDIRECT_URI points at http://127.0.0.1:42710/api/oauth/google/callback, which is almost certainly not a registered redirect URI on the Google OAuth client — the loopback flow will fail. Not needed for these tests.
A sandboxed HOME cannot see the user's login keychain; that is how test hosts stay isolated from the user's own Claude credential. Do not work around it.
No fixture exists for forcing a provider models endpoint to return non-2xx — inject at the network layer of the real daemon; the plan forbids mocking the daemon.
Never touch the production Hetzner box, never deploy, never merge to main. HETZNER_API_KEY is deliberately excluded from this stack's env.

spec.authority: The spec wins wherever it disagrees with the plan. Say so when it happens.
spec.modelRule: model is optional at every spawn; a chat takes its host's last-used model, seeded from the first catalogue the host reads successfully.
spec.cutover: clean re-pair, not a migration — build no migration code.

### THE OLD BLOCKER IS GONE — this is a genuine MULTI-MACHINE stack
The previous recipe reported that the server could register only ONE machine (`Registry.setDaemonKey` overwrote). Group B1 has since shipped: `registry.ts` now keys `daemonKeys` by `daemonId` ("a second machine ADDS a record rather than overwriting the first"), and `ws-hub.registeredDaemonIds()` returns all of them. VERIFIED LIVE: three daemons are registered, online and in the greeting at once. Every A-vs-B test is now exercisable.

### Surfaces and ports (all freshly probed free; nothing on 3000/5173/8080)
- **Server (HTTP + WS)**: http://127.0.0.1:42710 — `GET /api/healthz` -> `{"ok":true,"version":"0.1.374","gitSha":"010badd"}`. WS at `ws://127.0.0.1:42710/ws`.
- **Web SPA (Vite dev, real dev bundle, pre-authenticated)**: http://127.0.0.1:42741/app/ — proxies `/api` + `/ws` to :42710 and `/audio` to daemon A's :42723. Boots AUTHENTICATED (the `PATCH_DEV_WEB_CREDENTIAL` seam injects the JWT into `localStorage['patch.credential.v1']` in the index.html head — verified present in the served HTML). No `?credential=` needed.
- **Machine A — `host-a`**: healthz http://127.0.0.1:42721/healthz, audio ws://127.0.0.1:42723/audio/<sessionId>, UDS `/Users/tomchambers/patch-test-rig/hosts/host-a/home/.patch/daemon.sock`, PATCH_HOME `/Users/tomchambers/patch-test-rig/hosts/host-a/home/.patch`, sandbox HOME `/Users/tomchambers/patch-test-rig/hosts/host-a/home`. hostName `host-a`, **isHomeHost=true**, permissionModeDefault `bypassPermissions`, claude-code connected.
- **Machine B — `host-b`**: healthz http://127.0.0.1:42731/healthz, audio ws://127.0.0.1:42733, UDS `/Users/tomchambers/patch-test-rig/hosts/host-b/home/.patch/daemon.sock`, PATCH_HOME `/Users/tomchambers/patch-test-rig/hosts/host-b/home/.patch`, sandbox HOME `/Users/tomchambers/patch-test-rig/hosts/host-b/home`. hostName **`beta-box`** (persisted rename from an earlier run — do not assume it equals the daemonId), isHomeHost=false, permissionModeDefault `default`, claude-code connected.
